title: React Three Fiber against vanilla three.js on the same GA scene
question: The same instanced fretboard (lesson 13's Fretboard3D) in React Three Fiber, and the same objects built without React: what do R3F and React add to startup, per-frame CPU time, JavaScript heap and the production bundle?
hypothesis: R3F's per-frame overhead is small next to renderer.render(); its cost is at startup and in the bundle (React, ReactDOM, R3F).

predictions.metric: median CPU ms per frame, R3F minus vanilla
time to first frame, R3F minus vanilla
production bundle, gzip, R3F page minus vanilla page (three.js chunks excluded)
